basic_info.title: Deep Learning Scaling is Predictable, Empirically

method.notes: Pre-LLM evidence that generalization error follows power laws in training-set size across domains, with a plateau region at small data and an irreducible-error floor. Source of the DATA-SCALING ABLATION as the canonical 'model too small vs data-bound' discriminator: train the same model on {1/4, 1/2, 1x} data; improvement with data at fixed capacity = data-bound, saturation with high train loss = capacity- or signal-bound. Basis for experiment P1 in run2_capacity_diagnosis_and_scaling_review.md.

gap_analysis.whats_missing: Not a map-matching paper; methodology reference for the data-scaling diagnostic only.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Cited for the diagnostic procedure, not for any domain result.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Direct procedural relevance: P1 data-scaling ablation (200k->400k->800k Porto trajs) follows this recipe.
